title: Flexibility-Aware Clustering of Residential Electricity Consumption for Demand Response Targeting Using High-Resolution Smart Meter Data
description: Reproducible analysis software for flexibility-aware residential electricity-consumption clustering and demand-response targeting using the PLEGMA dataset. The workflow includes preprocessing and imputation, DTW and Euclidean load-profile clustering, flexibility-indicator extraction, flexibility-aware clustering, statistical validation, demand-response targeting, and sensitivity analysis across multiple numbers of clusters.
